notes: The terminal-user invariant: a v2-era task dir has no workflow: block, no gate_pending and no gates/ directory, so no rule can fire and an ordinary edit anywhere in the repo is allowed with empty stdout. This is also the latency case - nothing is read beyond the state files at the three fixed A4 depths. The replay harness mounts state_fixture at cwd_layout under a temporary directory and rewrites the payload cwd and every absolute path in the tool input to that mount point; the paths below are written against the canonical layout <cwd>/.maister/umbrella/runs/<run-id>/.
